content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

No-KYC payment gateways are platforms that allow you to accept payments without requiring Know Your Customer (KYC) verification. This means you can sell digital products like ebooks, courses, and templates without the hassle of lengthy sign-up processes or the risk of account freezes. In regions where traditional payment processors are unavailable, these gateways empower creators to monetize their work effectively. By using a low-fee option like NOWPayments, which charges just 0.5% per transaction, you maximize your earnings versus platforms like Gumroad, which takes 10%. This difference is crucial for sustaining a profitable digital business.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Deploying a no-KYC payment system involves several components working together seamlessly. You can host your product pages on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which are free and reliable. The backend logic can be managed using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, allowing for automated processes such as payment verification and order fulfillment. When a customer purchases a product, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain, triggering an automatic delivery of the digital product to the buyer. This architecture ensures you maintain complete control over your data and transactions without depending on third-party platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where conventional payment solutions are either unavailable or heavily restricted. It's ideal for anyone selling digital goods—such as ebooks, templates, and software—who wants to retain ownership of their sales data and avoid high processing fees. By utilizing a no-KYC payment gateway, creators can focus on their craft rather than worry about payment access and fees. This solution is especially beneficial for those experiencing financial isolation due to local economic conditions or government regulations.
Retain more profits by using NOWPayments instead of high-fee platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of a no-KYC payment solution include a reliable hosting service, a backend processing system, and a payment gateway. You can utilize GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your digital storefront. For backend logic, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can automate payment verification and product delivery. NOWPayments serves as the payment gateway, providing support for over 300 cryptocurrencies and enabling automatic on-chain payment verification. Together, these components create a robust and self-sufficient ecosystem for digital sales, ensuring creators can operate independently and efficiently.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first choose your hosting platform—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages are both excellent options. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate transactions and product delivery. Then, sign up for NOWPayments to facilitate crypto payments without KYC. Once everything is configured, you can start loading your products and set your prices. Ensure you test the entire process to confirm that everything works smoothly. For a comprehensive guide and resources, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all the necessary blueprints and templates you need to build and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Automate your payment processing without compromising data ownership.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

Absolutely. By deploying a no-KYC payment solution, you can sell templates and fonts directly from your own store without relying on third-party platforms.
What cryptocurrencies can I use with no-KYC payment gateways?
No-KYC payment gateways typically support a wide range of cryptocurrencies, with NOWPayments offering over 300 options, ensuring flexibility for your customers.
Is it hard to set up a no-KYC payment system?
Setting up a no-KYC payment system is straightforward. With platforms like GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, you can establish your digital store quickly and easily.
